name: NETRA
fullName: Neural Eye for Threat Recognition and Analysis
tagline: An AI-powered surveillance and intelligence platform that turns distributed camera feeds into real-time, searchable and connected situational intelligence.
type: Full-Stack AI Surveillance & Geospatial Intelligence Platform

aestheticTheme.name: Graphite & Ivory
aestheticTheme.description: Restrained, professional dark technology command-center environment with subtle glassmorphism and technical HUD accents.

corePhilosophy.doctrine: SEE → IDENTIFY → CONNECT → UNDERSTAND → ALERT → INVESTIGATE
corePhilosophy.ruleOfHonesty: Never fake AI detections or fabricate camera connected states. If AI is offline, display 'AI PROCESSING OFFLINE'. Simulated data must be explicitly branded as '[DEMO MODE]'.

workflow: CAMERA NETWORK (Wi-Fi / IP / RTSP / ONVIF / Local)
VIDEO INGESTION (TCP Socket Probing, RTSP handshake, Stream Proxying)
AI VIDEO PROCESSING (Python FastAPI inference bridge, frame sampling)
ANPR / OCR (Plate localization & Indian format regex normalization)
EVENT DETECTION (Restricted zones geofencing, crowd density, loitering)
WATCHLIST MATCHING (Hotlist queries with 60s cooldown deduplication)
CROSS-CAMERA TRACKING (Persistent vehicle identity & sequential node re-ID)
EVENT CORRELATION & REAL-TIME ALERTS (Socket.IO event bus)
OPERATOR COMMAND DASHBOARD (Live Monitor, Alert Center, GIS Vehicle Tracker)

frontend.technology: React 18 + Vite + Vanilla CSS Custom Properties + Socket.IO Client + Leaflet GIS

apiGateway.technology: Node.js + Express + Socket.IO Server + SQLite3 / PostgreSQL

aiEngine.technology: Python 3 + FastAPI + Uvicorn + OpenCV + NumPy + YOLO / EasyOCR integration

response.detections: array of { label, confidence, bbox: [x1, y1, x2, y2], trackingId }
response.plates: array of { plateText, normalizedPlate, confidence, bbox, region }
response.events: array of { type, zoneId, severity, message, confidence }

liveMonitor.title: NETRA LIVE MONITOR
hudElements: Network Status Badge (ONLINE / OFFLINE / CONNECTING / ERROR)
AI Status Tag with Neural Pulse
Indian License Plate Banner with Confidence Rating

alertCenter.title: NETRA ALERT CENTER
features: Multi-dimensional filtering (Severity, Camera, Date, Plate, Type, Acknowledged)
Forensic evidence dossier viewer with snapshot zoom
Direct escalation to Vehicle Tracker or Watchlist

vehicleTracker.title: NETRA VEHICLE TRACKER
features: Search by Plate Number, Partial Wildcard, Date Range
Interactive GIS Map (Leaflet) with customized dark cartography
Animated route polyline with vector directional arrows
Detailed sighting dossiers: Camera, Timestamp, Speed/Heading, Crop Snapshot, Confidence
Side-by-side chronological journey timeline with duration deltas

addCameraWorkflow.securityRule: Camera passwords are encrypted in secure storage and never reflected back in API responses.
addCameraWorkflow.testProtocol: Mandatory 'TEST CONNECTION' probe via TCP handshake before persistence.

cameraLab.title: NETRA CAMERA LAB
cameraLab.purpose: Hardware diagnostics, stream testing, and ONVIF discovery testbed.
capabilities: Live RTSP / HTTP URL ping and protocol validation

restrictedZonesEditor.title: NETRA RESTRICTED ZONES
capabilities: Vector polygon drawing directly over live camera frames
Multi-point boundary definitions with normalized coordinates
Configurable trigger severity and event classification
Real-time Ray-Casting point-in-polygon verification in AI service

analytics.title: NETRA ANALYTICS
analytics.rule: Honest visualizations derived directly from database aggregations.
charts: Incident Classification Breakdown (Watchlist vs Intrusion vs Density)
Peak Activity Hours Distribution (24-hour heat gradient)
Top Active Node Rankings & Detection Densities
Camera Network Fleet Uptime and Reliability Matrix

roles.permissions: Full administrative control, user provisioning, zone editing, credential management
Live surveillance, alert handling, acknowledgement, vehicle tracking, intelligence search
Read-only surveillance view, full access to tamper-evident audit logs and compliance reports

auditLogs.title: AUDIT LOGS
features: Immutable chronological log of all logins, stream tests, zone changes, and alert resolutions

settings.title: SYSTEM SETTINGS
sections: AI Inference Thresholds (Vehicle, Person, ANPR confidence)

endpoints.desc: Validate token and return user profile
Create a new camera (requires connection test)
Probe local subnet for ONVIF devices

channels.payload: Alert payload with severity, camera, plate, and snapshot
ANPR sighting broadcast across tracking listeners
Heartbeat telemetry with status, FPS, and latency
Global active counter updates (cameras online, threats)

verifiedCapabilities: Encrypted camera credential storage without frontend leakage
Honest AI status indication with offline handling
Labeling of simulated data with [DEMO MODE]
Persistent cross-camera trajectory tracking with Leaflet map (1 → 2 → 3 → 4)
Tamper-evident audit logging with SHA-256 chaining
Zero dead buttons or broken routes across the platform
